component.name: Stickler
component.summary: Write the drums of a song as sheet music

description.p: Stickler listens to the drums of a song and writes them down as sheet music, so you can play along. Drop a song in, and after about 15 seconds the drum part is on the screen.

ul.li: Kick, snare, toms, hi-hat and cymbals in drum notation, with bars and repeats
Play the song, the detected hits as clicks, or both, while the bar is marked
Fix the tempo, the time signature or the first beat in a second
Export the sheet music as PDF or MusicXML, or the drum track as FLAC or WAV

description.p: Everything runs on your computer. On first start, Stickler asks to download its two trained models once (about 2.2 GB). The model that detects the hits, ADTOF, is free for non-commercial use only.
Groundwork for the app: progress, cancelling and setup for every long step.
Honest numbers: the benchmark measures each model on the same footing.
Readable sheet music: bars, repeats and simplified patterns.
